voice.name: Open Sector - Warden
voice.description: Veteran male tank commander in his late forties, deep warm baritone with a faint gravelly Central European flavor, proud and utterly unflappable, speaks slowly and with dry confidence over a crackly tank intercom radio, the calm of a man who has survived a hundred battles and expects to survive this one.
voice.sample: Warden, at your command. Front plate is thick, the gun is long, and the crew is steady. Point me at the enemy and I will do the rest. No hurry, gentlemen. They are not going anywhere.

move: We get there when we get there.

fire.prompt: Distant, powerful boom of a modern main battle tank firing its main cannon in an open field.

move.prompt: Heavy modern tank turbine engine revving up and tracks starting to grind forward, short one-shot, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Heavy tank destroyed, internal ammunition explosion, massive metal blast with debris falling and fire crackle, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
